description.value: V-Show Karaoke is a karaoke bar in Burnaby offering air-conditioned indoor seating with a no-smoking policy. The venue accepts credit and debit cards and is wheelchair accessible. Touring cyclists may find it a convenient stop for evening entertainment and refreshment.
